name: Local model
short_desc: Private inference on this box or your own machine.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Run a pinned llama.cpp model server offline or reach your own tailnet machine. The app downloads SHA-verified GGUF weights; the model server has no internet. Another-machine addresses are owner settings. No cloud fallback or conversation logging.
